title: Best Social Media Copywriters (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a social media copywriter for captions and posts: what to include, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Social media copywriters write captions, hooks, post text and short scripts that fit each platform and your brand voice. Good copy makes people stop, read and respond. It goes wrong when every post sounds generic, the voice changes from week to week, or captions promise things the business cannot deliver. This guide helps you hire someone who can sound like you consistently.

faq.q: Is social media copywriting the same as social media management?
faq.a: No. A copywriter writes the words. A manager also plans, schedules, posts and responds to comments. Some people do both; check what is included.

faq.q: How many posts should I order?
faq.a: Enough for a regular schedule you can keep, for example a month of posts. Consistency matters more than volume.

faq.q: Can the writer match my voice?
faq.a: Yes, if you share examples of posts you like, words you use, and what to avoid. A short voice guide helps.
It depends on the platform. Ask the writer to suggest a small set of relevant hashtags rather than long lists.
